title: Transport of the cocartesian criterion from essential-image tests
statement: Use quasicategories, coherent Hom bifunctors, mapping-composition homotopies and whole-square pullback invariance from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], [lem-coef-infinity-hom-bifunctor-functoriality], [lem-coef-infinity-mapping-composition] and [lem-coef-kan-nerve-pullback-recognition]. Let $p:E\to B$ and $q:F\to B$ be inner fibrations of small quasicategories, let $T:E\to F$ be a functor equivalence with $qT=p$, and fix an edge $e$ of $E$. If the cocartesian criterion square for $T(e)$ is a homotopy pullback at every test vertex $Tz$ with $z\in E$, then it is a homotopy pullback at every vertex $w\in F$. The comparison for $w$ is obtained from an equivalence $Tz\to w$ and its image in $B$, with the coherent composition and inverse homotopies retained.

source.place: Essential-image test-object transport in the mapping-square marking argument extracted from Proposition 2.4.4.3 (dual), after the image-test comparison and before applying the cocartesian mapping criterion.
